articles.title: Tether says it completed long-promised 'Big Four' audit of finances behind $180 billion USDT stablecoin
articles.snippet: KPMG U.S. examined Tether's books and even counted its gold bars as the $180 billion USDT issuer said it completed its long-promised financial audit.

articles.title: Bullish shares surge 14% as subscription revenue offsets digital asset slowdown
articles.snippet: Bullish's second-quarter loss of $280 million was mostly attributable to a $244.6 million markdown on the company’s bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet unveils BitBonds with $1.3 million private debt sale
articles.snippet: The inaugural unsecured bonds offer annual interest of up to 4.3%, while exposing investors to metaplanet’s credit and bitcoin-linked balance-sheet risks

articles.title: Prediction markets should dial back faulty filings for incentives to boost trading: CFTC
articles.snippet: The U.S. regulator of platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket suggests the industry is getting into bad compliance habits that may allow for market abuse.

articles.title: Metaplanet CEO shuts down Bitcoin sale speculation after $322M transfer
articles.snippet: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich said no Bitcoin was sold after the company moved 5,014 BTC between custodial addresses for about $8 in fees.
